programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.sub_title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 3
programs.desc: Guy Fieri pairs the remaining six DDD chefs into teams and gives each duo under $20 to create a classic food duo; the top two teams continue their race for the $30,000 grand prize, while the bottom duo faces off in a seafood dinner budget battle.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.sub_title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 4
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the five remaining DDD chefs to make a burger and side using only nine ingredients; the bottom two chefs must shop fast and furious for ingredients to make takeout noodles to earn the last spot in the finale worth $30,000.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.sub_title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 5: Finale
programs.desc: Guy Fieri asks the final four DDD chefs to make updated diner classics; the three best chefs must prepare a dinner of champions using one ingredient from every aisle of the store to win the Grand Champion Trophy and the $30,000 grand prize.

programs.desc: A butchery with porchetta and a unique style of prosciutto in Portland, Ore.; In Louisville, Ky., a barbecue place serves wings and ribs; a café with steak sandwiches and chicken paninis in Hamilton, N.J.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: This trip, Guy Fieri travels the country diving into some meaty masterpieces starting at a spot in Longmont, Colorado, that serves craft beer and primo pub grub like their piled-high poutine burger.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Seattle, Guy visits a joint smoking up ribs and dishing out brisket chili; in Wilmington, N.C., he visits a breakfast spot getting dirty with their biscuits; in Oakland, Calif., Guy visits a spot serving up fried chicken, oxtails and collards.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: A Lansing, Mich., food truck dishes out shrimp burgers and a unique potato popper; a Bosnian restaurant in Tucson, Ariz., fires up legit Eastern European specialties; a down-home Southern seafood spot cooks up clam chowder and fries up favorites.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy digs into everything from pretzels to paella; in Bozeman, Mont., a five-star take on breakfast with a Mexican pork masterpiece; in Little Rock, Ark., a microbrewery serves elevated pub grub; a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant serving up paella.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
